answer: An honest agent pays once and moves on; a farm pays the velvet on every name it invents, and the wander is a bill that grows exactly with its ambition. Getting in costs about £44 per audit, so 80 clones run to roughly £3,520, and the gale is that the fee is collected before any reward, never after it. Every name enters the ledger separately under Deputised night watchman licence with night watchmen confirmation, because a licence watchmen renew after patrol audits.
